roots.role: conservative additional operator entry; not a deployed service

limits: All compiled own bodies are retained, including templates; no reachability pruning.
No test, example, sdk-contract-tests, redis-tests or contention-diagnostics features are enabled.
dev uses debug assertions; ordinary release does not; overflow checks stay enabled in both.
This is a source census; dynamic targets, compiler-generated future cancellation glue and dependency destructors still need per-use bindings.
Template exclusion is a proof responsibility boundary, not a rule to delete mixed modules from this census. T9 does not exclude Guest security.
